spread_measurement.method: fold-disciplined OLS actual_margin - spread_line ~ c + d*(mu_M_hat - spread_line); 79 evaluated weeks (75 fitted + 4 warmup < 50 prior rows), strict-prior fit sets, leak-safe asserted, sealed via median-of-fold
